title: Selection answer
statement: Given a table selection label, an optional state, an output-register value, an optional Boolean symbol, and a function assigning an optional Boolean symbol to each of the $k$ positions, the selection answer is determined as follows. For a state-and-output label it is true exactly when both supplied values match the label; for a symbol label without an index it is the symbol bit test on the supplied symbol; and for a symbol label with an index it is the symbol bit test on the symbol at that position.
